A quick note on these stat definition
boxes as we'll be meeting many of them
throughout this book:

It might seem logically contradictory to

Stat values are a gradual sliding scale.
The ranges given under 'interpretation'
are not intended to be taken completely
literally. It is obviously not the case that
this stat is low at 59 and suddenly
average at 60. I have intentionally
created these stat ranges so that the
